answer_1.quote: We aim to generate summaries with specified levels of readability, given an input document.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the readability with the FRE, GFI and CLI metrics (Sec. 2.2). We use BertScore (BS, and the F1 measure of ROUGE-L (RG-L, Lin, 2004) for evaluating the summary quality; and FactCC and UniEval for faithfulness assessment.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to determine how readable and informative the CNN/DM generated summaries are, using Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: We ask to select the most readable and the least readable summaries among three displayed summaries. For informativeness, we instruct annotators to mark the least informative and the most informative summary.
